arguments.sql: WITH src_counts AS (SELECT SourceAirport AS AirportCode, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM flights GROUP BY SourceAirport), dst_counts AS (SELECT DestAirport AS AirportCode, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM flights GROUP BY DestAirport), all_counts AS ( SELECT AirportCode, SUM(cnt) AS total FROM ( SELECT AirportCode, cnt FROM src_counts UNION ALL SELECT AirportCode, cnt FROM dst_counts ) GROUP BY AirportCode ), min_total AS ( SELECT MIN(total) AS min_total FROM all_counts ) SELECT a.AirportCode FROM airports a LEFT JOIN all_counts ac ON a.AirportCode = ac.AirportCode WHERE COALESCE(ac.total,0) = (SELECT min_total FROM min_total) ORDER BY a.AirportCode LIMIT 1
